newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Chamber of Commerce endorses budget.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Chamber of Commerce endorses budget.

text.p: The Sri Lanka Chamber of Commerce said on Thursday it fully endorsed the budget for fiscal 1997.

"The Ceylon Chamber is of the opinion that this budget is one of the more realistic budgets which has attempted to address and resolve the constraints for investment and development," the business group said in a statement.
The government had to take more steps "in support of selected sectors of the economy", it said without elaborating.
Wednesday's budget, which cut public spending and taxes and offered a series of incentives to industrialists, helped push the all share index up 2.78 points to 620.67.
